# Security Policy

## Supported Versions
Only the latest version of Home-Sapiens-Assistant is actively supported.

| Version | Supported          |
|--------|--------------------|
| latest | :white_check_mark: |
| older  | :x:                |

## Reporting a Vulnerability
If you discover a security vulnerability, please report it responsibly.

Do NOT open a public issue for security-related problems.

Instead, report it via:
- GitHub Issues (if not sensitive): https://github.com/odoricof/Home-Sapiens-Assistant/issues
- Or contact the maintainer directly if necessary.

## Scope
This integration interacts with Home Assistant and external devices/services configured by the user.

Security issues may include:
- Unauthorized access to devices
- Exposure of sensitive configuration data
- Authentication bypass or privilege escalation
